---
title: "Financial Modelling"
date: "2026-02-28"
---

- What is a financial modelling→Multi disciplinary, powerful communication tool for forecasting financial statement, based on different parameters and assumptions.
- Attributes of a good financial model
    - Dynamic - Changes are easily model, which runs across the model
    - Flexible - Easily expandable
    - Intuitive - Others can understand logic
    - Transparent - Easy to follow. No giant formula
    - Printable - It can be printed
    - Transferable - Others can use the model and make updates to it
    - Storytelling - Tell a story in a seamless flow
- Competencies required to build professional financial model
    - Design
    - Accounting understanding
    - Business operations
    - Finance
- Use cases of financial models for decision making
    - Valuation
    - Credit model
    - Operational issues
    - Risk & volatility
    - Mergers & acquisitions
- So many models are a mess
- Aspects where a financial model should work well
    - Electronically - Every formula work well and needs to make sense
    - On paper - Models need to work well on paper or pdf
